seeGravel: ...This place looks like a big array of intestines.
The maw of a giant creature waits to swallow me whole...
Gravel? Gravel. Maybe limestone deposits above. Must be careful. Must tread carefully.
What a place that waits for me! How long has it waited? What has it seen?
Oh? Oh, oh, oh? What sort of place are you, that I now walk upon?
Out of the cooking pot, into the fire.
I was a simple little labrat, and now I've escaped my cage...
eatGood: Very tasty. But is it good for me? That may be a different answer...
Tastes good, so very good! Perhaps even excellent!
This food brings joy and ease to my life.
I wonder, was food like this intended to be eaten, in the grand scheme of things?
What's this thing's nutritional value, I wonder?
eatMediocre: Hmm, the taste wasn't bad, but the scent... there was definitely something odd about that.
Not-so-sure that was good for me.
It's probably good for me, given how it tastes. I still do not appreciate it, however.
eatBad: Eugh! Quick, get it out, get it out! Urf, it might be too late...
refuseEat: I don't imagine that's the best menu option available.
But think of what would happen if I WERE to do so...!
No, no, even someone like me has limits.
tired: I feel as if I am trying to solve complex math problems simply by walking...
Hmm. I'm tired, but do I go on? SHOULD I go on? Much to think about, much to consider...
Oof. I'm getting sleepy... Very sleepy. But I'll be alright to keep going for a bit longer. I think I can handle that!
verytired: Can't... think... must sleep... no more thinking... nghhhh...
confused: Ah...? Ahhh? What is it...? What is it, now...?
wakeup: What's today's agenda, I wonder? Where to next? What is the next step?
Good morning- let's get going, shall we?
Wake up and smell the glowplantss...!
sad: I should not dwell. That would be counter-productive, yes...?
I believe the cogs of my brain may be rusted...
Certainly, I've felt worse. But I've also felt better.
This is not my most peak, ideal form... It could be worse, though.
gloomy: I would not say that this has all been worth it.
What is the issue? Where does it begin? Can it be cured?
bleeding: I do appear to be bleeding. It may be obvious, but of course, it may not, so I'd rather point it out to be sure.
Hello, my blood. We meet again. I must say, I appreciate you, but I'd rather see you less!
seecorpse: Oh, no... Are you dead? Why? Why are you dead? Can't you stop being dead, please? ...No?
A corpse! Here! But that's strange, I'M here TOO. Why am I in a place that corpses are in?
A dead body... How did you die? Did it hurt? Did you suffer? Or was it peaceful, like curling in someone's arms?
seecorpsedesensitized: I don't suppose I could bother you for a conversation on the current weather, now, can I?
You make up the residents of my little ghost town.
Excuse and pardon me for passing through!
watchlike: This watch is quite interesting! It tells me many details that I would struggle to contain otherwise. Very kind.
drillend: What a strange device I had activated. I do suppose the shortcut it's given me is priceless.
tradermeetnormal: Hello, hello, yes, I am here and I am present. Do you wish to trade?
Hello, friend. Make yourself at home, if you wish.
Hello, traveler. Make yourself at home, if you wish.
My my, I thought waiting for someone would be a waste of time when I started, and look at me now!
Hello to you, too, traveler. Whatever has carried you to my side?
Well met. Let us do business, yes?
Welcome to my pod. It is quite like other pods, except it is mine.
tradermeetgood: Hello, hello, hello! Friend, friend, welcome in, friend! Do you wish to trade, perhaps?
Oh? Is that a potential customer I see? Come in, come in, come in!
Hi! Welcome, welcome, I would love your company.
So, the world has brought me companionship after all!
Welcome to my corner of this drab little world! I am simply delighted to have you here.
tradermeetbad: Mmm... I don't know about this. I have a strange feeling about you, my sincerest apologies.
This mustn't be an eventful meeting, I'm afraid, there is an air of... unease about here.
Hello and all that, I suppose...
Please understand, I am not interested in conversing too terribly much.
traderseegun: And... do you greet everyone you meet with a barrel waggling toward their face? Come, now.
Behave, behave, stow your weapon. I will not be doing business if you act a fool.
traderhugsuccess: What a nice embrace! Thank you, friend. Let's hug again sometime.
Soft and kind...! Thank you very much.
traderhugfail: I do not wish to be touched at the moment, and I must insist you respect that.
Do not approach without warning! You will not gain my allyship in such a way!
traderwarning: Leave this place- I will not be saying so again, so hurry up and head out.
I do not appreciate your presence, so I must insist you make yourself scarce.

normal: There remains a world that saw us together for the last time...
Yup. That's me. I bet you're wondering how I got in this situation.
An unblinking, ever-wavering eye watches with great interest...
Do I talk to much? Be honest.
